evals.title: Collective credit and calibrated causality
evidence: Fresh Node 26.5.0 verification passed 31/31 tests in scripts/tests/knowledge-development-evals.test.mjs, 11/11 citation tests, TypeScript with --incremental false, and the knowledge-bank, citation, public-safety, and route checks. The deterministic runner reproduced the supplied fingerprint and reported zero social-archive or KD-013 violations.

Independent recomputation of apps/www/src/data/knowledge-bank/fixtures/nycartc-retrievable-population.json confirmed 3,123 unique source-status URLs: 608 account originals, 77 account replies, and 2,438 external-source native-repost records. It also confirmed 685 account-authored originals/replies, 15 quote-post reply-inheritance corrections, and two account-authored originals with separate native-self-repost-card appearances.

The 618 metric reproduced exactly from account-authored originals/replies having at least one displayed reply, repost, or like: 118 replies + 1,490 reposts + 2,698 likes = 4,306 units. The computation excludes 65 bookmarks and 152,536 views, including 19 bookmark/view-only records, and excludes engagement attached to all 2,438 external-source repost records.

scripts/lib/nycac-mission-classifier.mjs and the fixture reproduced all six signal counts—477 Fair Rent, 192 Save NYC Spaces, 97 Let NYC Dance, 62 Talks Not Raids, 57 nightlife governance, and 98 artist labor—with no rule/evidence or signal-array mismatches. A deterministic stratified sample covered every represented record-type/signal combination.

Fresh authenticated checks of public status URLs verified coalition-authored originals, conversation replies, external-author source statuses, and quote posts across all six mission signals. Statuses 1674013523373068289 and 1995868766614462973 are coalition-authored quote-post source statuses; status 1440685215110688779 remains an original even though its quoted card is a reply.

OBS-SOCIAL-NYCAC-RETRIEVABLE-POPULATION, CLM-NYCAC-SOCIAL-INFRASTRUCTURE, CLM-NYCAC-COUNCIL-SOCIAL-ENGAGEMENT, and RT-SOCIAL-NYCAC-OWNER-ARCHIVE keep source authorship, timeline appearance, stakeholder response, engagement, and the unmaterialized 2,001-record dependency distinct.

CLM-NYCAC-CABARET-REPEAL-CONTRIBUTION-CANDIDATE, CLM-NYCAC-TALKS-NOT-RAIDS-TESTIMONY, CLM-NYCAC-MARCH-TRANSPARENCY-LAW, and CLM-NYCAC-MARCH-REPLACED-BY-CURE separately represent Jamie's direct actions, multi-group contribution, Council enactment, later City action, and held causality.
findings: No material candidate defect was found. Individual action is stated directly without absorbing coalition, collaborator, Council, agency, venue, or elected-official credit.

Literal recovery of all 5,124 profile-counted posts is explicitly rejected. RT-SOCIAL-NYCAC-OWNER-ARCHIVE is critical, blocked, owner-assigned, and requires reconciliation before any stronger population claim.

Environment limitation, not a candidate defect: public status pages verify source-status identity and quote-post structure, but historical self-repost appearances and full false-negative classifier replay depend on the unavailable private raw/profile capture. The candidate discloses both limits.
evals.recommended_next_move: No remediation required. Preserve the two-axis taxonomy and causal boundaries; update the 3,123-of-5,124 claim only after the owner archive is privately reconciled.

evals.title: Source-backed strength through Chad's lens
evidence: apps/www/src/data/work.ts presents Jamie as Co-Founder, Civic Systems & Policy Communications and names concrete outputs: campaign websites, a six-part operating plan, 30+ pages of shared memory, a legislative provenance redline, action tracking, public testimony, and privacy-preserving data requirements.

apps/www/src/content/work/fair-rent-nyc.mdx is organized around what became usable, what Jamie did, civic outcomes, how collaborators used the work, evidence boundaries, and transferable technical-project-management value.

CLM-NYCAC-COFOUNDER-ROLE-CANDIDATE, CLM-NYCAC-CABARET-REPEAL-CONTRIBUTION-CANDIDATE, CLM-NYCAC-TALKS-NOT-RAIDS-TESTIMONY, and CLM-NYCAC-OFFICE-NIGHTLIFE-ACCOUNTABILITY give Jamie specific actor-led value while preserving collaborator and institutional roles.

The active CLM-NYCAC-SOCIAL-INFRASTRUCTURE paragraph is concise: it states the shared account's functions, six campaign/policy lines, review of 3,123 retrievable URLs, and the no-individual-authorship boundary. It omits the 608/77/2,438 taxonomy, 5,124 counter, and 2,001-record mechanics from the hiring-facing paragraph.

Fresh resolution of the fair-rent-nyc/social-infrastructure citation occurrence confirmed the exact boundary: source note SRC-SOCIAL-NYCAC-RETRIEVABLE-POPULATION-2026-07-14 states 5,124 profile posts, the 2,001-record owner-archive gap, and the non-claims; the linked fixture and canonical claim boundaries retain the complete 685/2,438/two-appearance taxonomy.

The unresolved queue is prioritized and testable without burdening the public narrative: RT-SOCIAL-NYCAC-OWNER-ARCHIVE and RT-NYCAC-OFFICE-CREATION-CONTRIBUTION are critical; RT-SOCIAL-NYCAC-ACCOUNT-ESTABLISHMENT-CORROBORATION and RT-NYCAC-FIREGUARD-PASS-RATE-CORROBORATION are high priority. Their stronger claims remain held.
findings: No material hiring-legibility defect was found. A hiring manager can identify Jamie's role, artifacts, direct advocacy, usable operating results, official outcomes, and explicit limits without reading the underlying archive.
The social archive supports coalition-level infrastructure rather than pretending to prove Jamie's post-level authorship. Jamie's account-establishment claim remains dormant pending corroboration.
The detailed taxonomy and owner-archive mechanics remain available through the citation layer instead of overtaking the composed case study.
evals.recommended_next_move: No editorial remediation required. Preserve the concise projection and pursue the prioritized owner-archive, account-establishment, Office-creation, and Fireguard research only to mature currently held claims.
